name: Shotwick Castle
place: Shotwick Park, Cheshire West and Chester, England
summary: Shotwick Castle is a Norman medieval fortification near the village of Saughall, Cheshire, England. Construction began in the late 11th century. Its purpose was to control a crossing point on the River Dee between England and Wales. The site is a scheduled monument. No masonry features remain above ground except for earthworks.
aka: Shotwick Castle motte and bailey and late medieval garden remains
